title: The Most Shocking Climate News of 2026
author: Robert Hunziker
content:
[![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/casey-horner-
qEkjPNRz-F0-unsplash-680x453.jpg)](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/08/04/the-
most-shocking-climate-news-of-2026/)

![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/casey-horner-
qEkjPNRz-F0-unsplash-680x453.jpg)

Image by Casey Horner.

The UK Green Party’s former leader Caroline Lucas recently nailed the Labor
Party for “burying the most explosive report” of the year by UK military and
intelligence sources. The concealed report warns “that the global collapse of
ecosystems poses grave threats to the UK’s security and food supply within as
little as five years.” (Source: _As Europe Burns, a Climate Cover-Up
Continues_ , [The Nation](https://www.thenation.com/article/environment/as-
europe-burns-a-climate-coverup-
continues/?fbclid=IwY2xjawTYvfpwZG9mAWV4dG4DYWVtAjEwAGJyaWQRMWZYSXFaMlhpeDBjUVJ0aDhzcnRjBmFwcF9pZBAyMjIwMzkxNzg4MjAwODkyAAEewcQYTHp_LVvc3hkJIo0VawXHOaw4bpl1u33xSGf-
tzbLdYK3LG8c_p0WI0Y_aem_u0UXTgPxv4izmS24pFeyWw), July 30, 2026)

“The UK ‘has no future’ if it cannot ‘restore the natural world on which we
rely for our food, water, and clean air,’ said Chris Hinchliff, who is among
the members of Parliament pressing the government to release the full report,
rather than a shorter, redacted version. Even that version, which was obtained
by The Guardian’s Fiona Harvey, ‘paints a devastating picture of severe food
shortages, price rises, migration, political destabilization, and possible
war, resulting from the collapse of ecosystems, fueled by the human-induced
climate crisis and over-exploitation,” Ibid.

Global collapse of ecosystems, if realized, if in fact it truly happens within
five years, is certain to create havoc throughout the world, but no
governments, other than this leak of a high-ranking report, has suggested to
the public the risks of collapse of ecosystems leading to food shortages with
panic and fighting. Why not?

After all, it was only a few months ago that an esteemed panel of UK
scientists held a public forum, i.e., [UK National Emergency
Briefing](https://www.counterpunch.org/2025/12/05/uk-national-emergency-
briefing-wakes-up-world/) d/d November 27, 2025, that essentially spelled out
the same problem with powerful evidence of near-term collapse of some
ecosystems. Why don’t the nations of the world confront the causes and inform
the public as soon as possible? In five years, it’ll be too late to inform
anybody. The only way to get the public onside to help fight this scourge is
to explain the issue to the public and requests they embrace efforts to
mitigate.

Spain’s PM recently declared a “climate emergency,” with scorching fires
consuming much of the countryside for the second year in a row. PM Pedro
Sanchez called on political parties “across the ideological spectrum ‘to reach
an agreement, a State pact, (and) to address the climate emergency,” Ibid.

Throughout the EU extreme heat is sucking soils dry and destroying
agricultural crops. In America, nearly 50% of the Lower States are in some
level of drought. The Rocky Mountain “water towers for the Southwest”
experienced dreadfully scattered snowfall and the entire Colorado River
Complex that feeds water to 40 million people is broken, Lakes Mead and
Powell, the two largest reservoirs in the United States, are at dangerously
low levels. The emergency recognized by PM Sanchez is “everywhere as an
emergency.” Spain is not alone.

But governments throughout the world are too timid to be effective and thus
seduce their constituencies by greenwashing or ignoring reality often in
concert with media. They can’t face the truth because they don’t have any good
answers or they’re paid off to ignore the truth, to hide it from the public.
Sadly, politics are for sale to the highest bidders that could care less about
public welfare. If they truly cared, problems like this would already be
addressed.

Which is good reason for people to rise up against incompetent leaders. The
world is infested with them. For example, “Aides to former Labour prime
minister Keir Starmer twice quashed plans to release the UK report… allegedly
for fear that the climate-denying Reform UK Party would attack Labour for
putting climate concerns ahead of the cost of living,” Ibid. How bloody stupid
is that?

“Climate denial persists in the UK media as well: Even as wildfires scorched
Europe, the front page of the Rupert Murdoch–owned The Times of London
featured a rant against the net-zero emissions goal that scientists say is
essential to preserving a livable planet,” Ibid. Oh please, this is beyond
stupidity. It’s something worse than stupidity.

This kind of behavi0r by weak-kneed leaders is sickening. It’s insulting to
the public. It’s a crime against humanity to fail to tell the truth
accompanied by outrageously blatant failure to search for answers, mitigation
measures, exploring whatever can be done to protect citizens but alas, at the
end of the day, failing to protect them.

This failure of leadership in the world started in earnest for all to see when
195 nations agreed at Paris 2015 that CO2 emissions from burning fossil fuels,
oil, gas, and coal cause global warming, and they all agreed to cut these
harmful emissions. Today, less than a handful of those original 195 nations
will even come close to meeting their obligations. They have failed. The
public deserves to know the truth about their failure, and why it
unintentionally but ridiculously promotes excessive global heat throughout the
planet today.

It’s even worse than that, according to The Nation, most news outlets across
Europe are not reporting the “influence of climate change driving the massive
fires.” But they are providing images of people having fun on the beach with
massive fires raging in the distant background. Oh please!

**The Most Shocking Aspect: The Public Knows**

“Covering Climate Now’s [89 Percent Project](https://89percent.org/)
spotlights the reality that 80 to 89 percent of the world’s people want their
governments to [take stronger climate
action](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41558-024-01925-3). In this summer of
smoke and fire, the public is waiting for their politicians and their press to
respond. ‘Voters are much more tuned into this than most of our [elected]
representatives are,’ author [George Monbiot
said](https://x.com/Channel4News/status/2081780920206430423?s=20) on the UK’s
Channel 4. ‘And indeed than most of the media is,” Ibid.

That’s 80-89% of the world’s people want their governments to take stronger
climate action. But ever since WWII, the United States has been the world
leader in many respects, especially militarily. It is the only country with
military in 80 countries with 750 individual bases. No nation is in such a
favorable position to assist the world in fighting battles. Yet, the U.S. is
promoting fossil fuels that assist excessive heat whilst ignoring fierce
battles against climate-induced wildfires throughout the world. Hmm.
